purpose: Teach: 初代/何者/イスラム教/首長/巡礼/検閲/押収/老朽

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、初代、絶対、社長、絶対、理念、絶対、継承しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our company to inherit the founding president's philosophy. This is serious — I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Speaks with the weight of leadership — not rushed, but each phrase lands. Slight pause between the philosophy statement and the personal appeal. Firm without being harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同業他社、本気で、絶対、何者、絶対、か、絶対、調査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're conducting thorough investigations into our competitors. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Calm, precise delivery. Each task acknowledged like items being checked off. Respectful but not obsequious — the tone of someone who understands the assignment and will execute it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、イスラム教、絶対、圏、絶対、進出、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want you to seriously consider our expansion into Islamic markets. Study it carefully.
lines.style: Measured command. Slightly more deliberate than the first instruction — this is new territory. Pauses after 'Islamic markets' to let the weight of strategy land. Not urgent, but important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中東、本気で、絶対、首長、絶対、国、絶対、お得意様、絶対、訪問しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've already visited key clients in the Middle East, particularly in the Emirates. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Steady, efficient report. Demonstrates he's already been working on this. Respectful pace — not defensive, just informative. Clean closure on 'opportunity.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、巡礼、絶対、シーズン、絶対、商機、絶対、捉えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The pilgrimage season is a real business opportunity. I need you to identify how we can capitalize on it.
lines.style: Slightly more energized than the previous direction. Sees an opening — the tone shifts from general strategy to spotting a specific window. Still controlled, but with forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内情報の、本気で、絶対、検閲、絶対、避け、絶対、自由な議論、絶対、推進、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're making sure internal discussions stay open and free from censorship. I appreciate your faith in us.
lines.style: Confident affirmation. Speaks to something deeper than just task completion — there's a hint of pride in how he says 'free discussion.' Warm respect woven through the professionalism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫の、本気で、絶対、押収、絶対、品、絶対、対応しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Handle the seized warehouse inventory. It needs immediate attention.
lines.style: Clipped, urgent shift. The tone tightens — this is a problem needing solving. Less philosophical, more tactical. Quick and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、老朽、絶対、設備、絶対、更新、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're replacing the aging equipment now. We'll have it resolved quickly. Thank you.
lines.style: Brisk, action-oriented. The word 'now' carries momentum — he's already moving on it. Brief and reassuring. Clean, professional closure that signals completion.
